claim_boundary: Publication-supported plume scale facts and independently audited upstream conversion facts may be recorded before the source archive is fully calibrated, but Program A may not sample the plume until exact source bytes, axis signs/source origin, and bilateral anatomical sensor geometry independently pass review.

array_axis_mapping.authority_statement: Dryad frames arrive downwind-by-crosswind, (406, 216); after transposition the first 351 downwind columns are retained and four zero rows are added to each crosswind edge.

notes: The eLife methods report a PLIF imaging region extending up to 30 cm downwind and 8 cm to either side of the centerline.
The acquisition was 15 Hz and the camera was binned to a nominal 0.74 mm/pixel.
Independent upstream reproduction code resolves raw array axis roles as axis0=downwind and axis1=crosswind.
Axis role evidence does not establish the positive direction of either raw axis, the source index/origin, or the exact relation between the archived field and the physical source location.

bilateral_sensor_geometry.candidate_landmark_definition: centroid of the olfactory third antennal segment (funiculus) on each side in a scale-calibrated frontal/body-centered projection
forbidden_authority: assuming exact bilateral symmetry without measurement

pass_requirements: exact plume source bytes are SHA-256 verified
archived spatial-axis roles, signs, source origin, and scale are explicitly resolved
left and right anatomical sampling landmarks are independently measured from a scale authority
physical plume and bilateral geometry hashes are frozen before any navigation performance
